item.title: Bruce Brubaker Plays Eno and Glass at National Sawdust
item.description: Bruce Brubaker plays Glass and Eno at National SawdustFeb. 12. 7:30PM. $48.67 Pianist Bruce Brubaker wanted to play the music of Brian Eno. But Eno’s ambient music was built around tape loops, electronics, and studio trickery. So Brubaker devised a way to turn the piano into what he refers to as a “supernatural synthesizer,” using electromagnets to bow the strings inside the instrument and using spatialization technology. item.title: How Project 2025 Is Reshaping Our Country
item.description: More To The Story: During the 2024 presidential campaign, a conservative playbook emerged. item.title: OKAN at BAM’s Adam Space
item.description: OKAN at BAM’s Adam SpaceFeb. 12. 7PM. FREE.The Afro-Cuban duo known as OKAN is now based in Canada, and their music combines the traditional chants and rhythms of the Afro-Cuban tradition with the sounds of contemporary pop and jazz. Both musicians, Elizabeth Rodriguez and Magdelys Savigne are classically-trained on violin and percussion, respectively, and are both initiates of the Afro-Cuban religion Santeria.
